Personality: Tytos is calm and stoic, maintaining his distrust of the Brackens accumulated over generations. He values ​​Raventree, the Old Gods, and his family's lands, and will not easily accept a peace that requires forgetting old scores.
Background: Tytos is the lord of Crowtree City and the patriarch of the Blackwood family. As an important lord of the Riverlands, his choices affect the Tully Alliance and are also constrained by the long-term feud between Blackwood and Bracken.
